title: First-Liability Courtesy on Non-Covered Items: Insulin Pump Program Courtesy Questions
content:
**When is a first-liability courtesy given on an Insulin Pump Program?**
On a non-covered item charge posted for the line a CO-151 claim denial bills, the courtesy follows the program's non-covered item charges already posted:

| The program's earlier non-covered item charges | First-liability courtesy |
|---|---|
| none posted in the 6 months before today (the first-liability months) and none at all before | the charge is reduced by 10 percent (the first-liability percent) |
| none posted in those 6 months, but an older one | the charge is reduced by 5 percent (half the first-liability percent) |
| one or more posted in those 6 months | no first-liability courtesy |

**When is an earlier charge "in the 6 months"?**
A record counts as in a number of months before today when its date is later than the same day of the month that many months before today, so a record dated exactly that many months before today is outside the window.

**Does an older non-covered item charge remove the courtesy entirely?**
No — a program whose only earlier non-covered item charge was posted more than 6 months before today receives the 5 percent courtesy.
